profile.name: Kamran Ali
profile.title: Senior UI/UX Engineer
profile.bio: Senior UI/UX Engineer with 7+ years of experience owning end-to-end frontend development and UI design across enterprise SaaS platforms, AI-powered products, and high-traffic web applications. Currently building Goalytics, an AI-powered OKR platform, at Digital Gravity. Expert hand-coder of HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and pixel-perfect React.js interfaces translated directly from Figma, with a daily AI-assisted development workflow (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor).

projects.name: Goalytics
projects.description: AI-powered OKR platform (goalytics.io) — turns company strategy into aligned execution through Objectives & Key Results. Real-time collaborative Socket.io sessions where teams build goals together, Claude-powered AI suggestion workflows for goal generation and weightage balancing, role-based dashboards (Admin, Manager, Participant, Viewer), multi-step onboarding, and PDF export.

projects.name: Vettio
projects.description: AI recruitment platform that runs structured, domain-aware video/voice interviews with every applicant and produces instant, explainable shortlists. Owned the enterprise SaaS design system end-to-end, including real-time LiveKit-driven voice interview UI managing concurrent data streams and complex async states.

projects.name: Savyour
projects.description: Pakistan's cashback & deals platform (savyour.io) — real-time deal discovery with cashback stacking on top of existing brand discounts across 400+ partner brands, an in-app wallet, price-drop alerts, a referral program, and a browser extension for checkout savings.

projects.name: TaskQue
projects.description: Cloud-based task management platform for teams. Its 'Que' system automatically routes new tasks to whichever team member is actually free, with customizable Agile/Waterfall/hybrid workflows and integrations with Slack, Google Drive/Docs, and Dropbox.

projects.name: Rocky Run
projects.description: Single-page landing site built for event registration.

projects.name: DesignUps
projects.description: Single-page landing site for a creative agency.

projects.name: AUTOFOCUS Energy
projects.description: Single-page e-commerce landing site for an energy drink brand.

experience.description: Building Goalytics end to end: pixel-perfect React.js UI from Figma specs, real-time multi-user Socket.io collaboration (live brainstorming, voting, commenting, presence), Claude AI-powered suggestion interfaces with review/accept/modify/reject controls, role-based UI architecture (Admin, Manager, Participant, Viewer), multi-step onboarding flows, and REST API integration with backend engineers.

Owned the UI/UX of a production enterprise SaaS platform end to end, from Figma wireframes through hand-coded, pixel-perfect React.js/Next.js implementation. Built and maintained a design system and shared component library that cut delivery time by 40%, implemented WCAG-aligned accessibility practices, built real-time LiveKit-driven voice interview features, improved Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals scores by 35%, led code reviews and mentored junior developers, and maintained CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Vercel (50% better deployment reliability).

Built responsive, accessible web interfaces using React.js, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and Bootstrap, translating Figma and PSD designs into pixel-perfect, cross-browser-compatible production code. Maintained marketing-facing landing pages alongside product UI and migrated a legacy WordPress frontend to a modern React.js component architecture.
Built responsive, accessible UI components for TaskQue using Angular and TypeScript, integrating REST APIs and real-time data feeds with clean, W3C-standard markup in Agile sprint cycles.

Designed and developed responsive marketing websites and landing pages using hand-coded HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, translating Figma/PSD layouts into pixel-perfect, brand-consistent interfaces for design and marketing stakeholders.
